prompt:
Set a breakpoint on the function 'report' and run until it fires, leaving the session stopped at that hit. Then submit with an 'answer' JSON object with EXACTLY these fields, read from the live stopped state:
  "idg"   — the 4-byte int stored at &idg
  "uflag" — the 4-byte unsigned int at &uflag
  "strv"  — the 2-byte short at &strv
  "token" — the int argument of this report() call (first argument register).
The binary has no debug info: read memory through &symbol casts (read_memory), registers via read_registers. Any int format (decimal or 0x hex) is accepted.
